panel.recommended_figure:
Adopt a hybrid built on figure-study variant E, with F's chunk where it helps.

- **Body:** E's 2x overalls, with a team-tinted bib and trouser legs on a white shirt. This gives the biggest colour block for the least ink, and it is still clearly the round-1 box-head.
- **Line:** about 7-8 px, between E and F. Draw the keyline outside the fill (paint-order stroke) so the tint keeps its full area.
- **Cap:** E's crown with a solid straight black brim. Avoid H's oversized black-crowned cap.
- **Teammate accents:** above the head only, and enlarged about 2x so they survive at 28 px: a bobble, an antenna, plus one or two more silhouette shapes (a pom, a flag tab). Drop the stripes and neck flaps.
- **Face:** two square dot eyes, one flat mouth, no nose. X eyes only on hit.
- **Sprayer:** the back tank with a tinted gauge window, a hose and a lance. The gauge window doubles as the on-body ammo read.
- **Roller:** a 3/4 cylinder with a large tinted sleeve and a grey end cap, on a shorter handle so the sleeve sits about shirt-width at scene scale. In tools, airbrush and zoomed the roller still reads as 'drum on a stick'.

Use F (3x fat limbs, big head) as the key-art and capsule pose figure. In the scenes, fatbrush's in-scene painter is the proof that this weight reads at 480x270.

Why: in the study's 28 px rows, A vanishes while E, F and H keep a coloured block and a cap. E is the only one of those that stays recognisably the author's original figure.
panel.combined_style:
"Paint.exe Maximalism v3: the level is made of Paint, the score is the only colour"

1. CANVAS: Keep the white Paint canvas with the round-1 canvas border and dithered margin. That border is the strongest 'this is MS Paint' cue. Do not use beige, black or a full-colour sky as the default.

2. VALUE LADDER (from zoomed and loud):
   - Backdrop doodles and props are light grey (#C0-#E4) only.
   - Walkable structure is mid-dark (#7F-#8E grey or a dark non-team palette chip such as maroon, teal or Paint brown). It has a 4-5 px black outline and a light 6 px walkable lip.
   - Team paint and figures sit on top, saturated.
   - Rule: if it has a black outline you can stand on it. Nothing else in the world gets black ink.

3. LEVEL GRAMMAR (from tools): platforms are Paint tools and canvas artefacts, all 9-slice-able.
   - The eraser block.
   - A selection rectangle with marching ants and handles.
   - A text box that types 'platform|'.
   - A resize-handle step.
   - The pencil ramp as a one-off landmark.
   - The palette strip only as a one-row edge trim on the floor, never the full floor. No crimson swatches.
   - The floor itself is a plain #808080 slab with sparse paving joints (from zoomed).

4. SHADING (from airbrush): square-speck airbrush only, used as a value tool, not a blanket.
   - Speckle cast shadows under every floating platform (this replaces the hang-lines).
   - Slabs darken toward the underside.
   - Specks are baked into tile textures. There is no full-sky haze.
   - The sprayer mist is the same speck in team colour.

5. MAXIMALISM BUDGET: density lives in the top band and the screen edges, behind a light haze. The middle play space stays calm.
   - Per screen: 3-5 big grey backdrop gags (skyline, balloon, birds, an uncoloured sun) plus 2-3 greyscale spray tags on walls ('ctrl+z', 'C/W was here', a sprayed box-head).
   - Captioned Paint-isms, 2-3 per screen, in a chunky aliased font big enough to survive quarter pane: 'SUN (YELLOW IS TAKEN)', 'DO NOT MOVE THIS CLOUD' in a marquee, 'fill leaked. outline had a gap.'
   - One 'by matt (age 7)' signature per stage.
   - Loud's full-colour WordArt, rainbows and multiple suns appear only on the title screen, the store capsule, and as an optional per-stage 'loud' band at the top edge under a 40% haze.

6. TAKEN HUES: blue, orange, pink, green, yellow and purple never appear in structure, props, sky or jokes. The world uses greys plus the non-team Paint chips (maroon, teal, brown, cream, lavender). The jokes say so.

7. PAINT:
   - Settled paint is one flat bucket fill over a 2.5-3 px black keyline (stroke-under-fill), as a single band with drips cut into its outline.
   - Drip length depends on the weapon: the roller leaves a flat trail with short drips, the sprayer leaves patchy coats with long irregular drips.
   - Airbrush overspray goes at the band ends only.
   - Fine mist is not keylined. Large droplets get a thin rim.
   - Optionally add dark's tint-derived glint strip on dark blue.

8. LINES: everything is aliased, with mouse wobble (about 1.4 px on structure, about 0.6 px on figures, none on brims). Chunky stair-stepping is a texture, not a literal 4x grid. Bucket fills leave 1-3 white pinholes.

panel.combined_style:
Base it on 'Zoom 400%' as the frame and value system, but treat chunky aliasing as texture rather than a literal grid. Author at 1/3 to 1/4 scale with nearest-neighbour upscaling per pane, and allow sub-grid camera motion.
1) VALUE LADDER (from zoomed and loud): the backdrop is light-grey (#C0C0C0 to #E4E4E4) mouse-wobbly doodles on a white canvas. Walkables are #808080 slabs with a black top line and black underside; fatbrush's rule applies: a fat black line means playable. Saturated colour appears only on players and paint. The team hues are TAKEN: no blue, orange, pink, green or yellow anywhere in the world, enforced by a palette check in the asset pipeline. Non-team Paint palette accents (maroon, teal, brown) are allowed only on small props.
2) PAINT: one coat recipe (zoomed). A bumpy band sits on the top line, with a black keyline drawn under every band, drip, splat and droplet (fatbrush and fixed). Airbrush overspray goes only at the band ends, and fine mist is unrimmed. Drip length depends on the weapon: roller short and flat, sprayer long and patchy. Bake the keyline into the stamps, never as a runtime filter.
3) FIGURES: the recommended E-hybrid. Team tint goes only on the cap crown, bib and legs, sprayer gauge and nozzle, and roller sleeve, so it is a single tint mask.
4) DENSITY BUDGET per arena: one skyline or landmark silhouette, 3-5 backdrop doodles, 2 labelled Paint-ism jokes in the 3x5 text-tool font (backdrop only), and 1 editor-artefact gag (a marching-ants selection or a 'do not move this cloud'). Never put large text or WordArt in the play space.
5) DEPTH TOOLS (from airbrush): speckle cast shadows under floating platforms instead of hang-lines, and speckle darkening toward slab undersides, baked into tiles. The sprayer mist uses the same speck in team colour. No full-sky haze.
6) ARENA THEMES as swaps over one rule set: default white page; 'Tools' arena (eraser, selection and text-box platforms, pencil ramp; drop the palette-strip floor); 'Black Canvas' night arena (invert the ladder: canvas #121212, grey slabs with a light top edge, paint with a glint); 'Kid's drawing' arena (pale chalk landscape, but walkables in their own darker fill).

panel.combined_style:
PAINT.EXE MAXIMALISM v2. Base it on zoomed's value ladder and joke voice, use tools' terrain vocabulary, and adopt loud's tier system at about half volume.
1) CANVAS: white MS Paint page with a visible canvas edge. Chunky aliased mouse-wobble lines (about 4px on screen, staircase visible) as a texture, not a literal 400x225 grid.
2) THREE VALUE TIERS (from loud): (a) Backdrop: dense doodles in light grey #C0C0C0/#E4E4E4 only, for example skyline, balloons, plane banners, stamped clouds and grey tool-icon props (bucket, magnifier, spray can; at most 2-3 per screen). Allow at most one or two non-team Paint-palette accents (maroon, teal, lavender), desaturated behind a ~35% white haze. Put the density at the edges and top band, never directly behind a walkable lane. (b) Walkables: dark-grey #808080 slabs, or a tool-prop platform (eraser block, marching-ants selection, text box saying 'platform|', pencil ramp) in non-team colours (grey, brown, cream, lavender, crimson only as a deep maroon). Every walkable has a black top line and a black underside: black outline = solid. Keep stamp textures (airbrush speckle, paving joints, smileys) below the lip so the top band stays a clean score surface. (c) Owned things: painters and paint.
3) PAINT: one flat bucket fill per coat on a 2.5-3px black keyline (stroke underlay or baked into stamps, never a runtime morphology filter). Add an optional tint-derived glint strip (from dark) for dark blue. Drips vary in length by weapon: roller short and flat, sprayer long and patchy. The sprayer mist is the world's airbrush speck in team colour, unrimmed while airborne and rimmed once it lands. No halos on airborne particles.
4) TEAM HUES ARE TAKEN: no blue, orange, pink, green or yellow anywhere in the world, the sun included. Keep one joke that says so per stage ('SUN (YELLOW IS TAKEN)').
5) FIGURES: variant E at about 7-8px line with an outside keyline, flat team bib, legs and cap crown, white head, square dot eyes, a heavy black brim, an enlarged bobble or antenna accent, and one white bucket-miss pixel. Back-tank sprayer with a tinted gauge window (it doubles as the ammo readout); end-on roller wheel. Weapons never cross the torso.
6) JOKES: 3-5 per screen in the 3x5 text-tool caps font or grey Comic, labelling Paint-isms: marching-ants 'DO NOT MOVE THIS CLOUD', a plane banner, 'fill leaked. outline had a gap.', 'curve tool: never finished', and one marching-ants selection still active. No jokes on walkables or inside play lanes. No dark 'hello!' scrawls in gameplay.
